text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Document gathering and student council 
interviews are complete... Aside from the 
members questioning the teachers, let's 
move on to the next task.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Trainer. Thank you for your hard work. 
We are currently researching the academy's 
history for a group assignment.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Progress is going smoothly. It's all 
thanks to our excellent team members.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
I intend to continue doing my best to 
support everyone as their leader. 
...Because being relied upon makes me 
happy.
